prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objective “best” agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and preferred working style. I can help you pick the best fit. To start, tell me the answers to a few quick questions — or I can give a general shortlist and evaluation checklist.

Questions (pick any that apply)
- Primary goal(s): SEO, paid search (PPC), social ads, content/brand, CRO, analytics, full-funnel growth, creative/brand work?
- Industry: B2B or B2C? SaaS, ecommerce, finance, healthcare, etc.?
- Monthly budget range for agency services (ballpark)?
- Team size/type you prefer: boutique specialist vs. large full-service agency?
- Timeline: ongoing retainer, 3–6 month campaign, or one-off project?
- Any must-have capabilities: HubSpot/Google/Bing/Meta certifications, enterprise experience, privacy/compliance requirements?

If you want a quick starting point, here’s a practical approach and some examples:

How to evaluate agencies
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (avoid vague claims).
- Industry or channel expertise (SEO, PPC, social, ecommerce).
- Transparent reporting and clear KPIs.
- Client references and recent reviews (Clutch, G2, The Manifest).
- Tools & certifications (Google Partner, Meta Business Partner, HubSpot, GA4).
- Communication style and cultural fit (frequency, points of contact).
- Pricing model and contract flexibility.

Where to search and verify
- Clutch.co and The Manifest (filter by San Francisco + service).
- Google Partners / Ads agencies directory.
- LinkedIn company pages and client testimonials.
- Award lists (Cannes, Webby, Drum, Ad Age) for creative shops.

Examples of well-regarded agencies with San Francisco presence (each has different strengths)
- Goodby Silverstein & Partners — creative/brand and campaign work (large, high-profile creative).
- Razorfish (part of Publicis) — digital transformation and integrated marketing work.
- Jellyfish — performance marketing, paid media, analytics (global agency with SF presence).
- Victorious — SEO-focused agency headquartered in SF (strong SEO specialization).

Next step
If you tell me your goals, industry and budget I’ll build a tailored shortlist of 4–6 San Francisco agencies (with what they’re best at, likely pricing band, and suggested interview questions) or draft an outreach template you can use to solicit proposals. Which would you prefer?
